name: Myeloid effector immunity in hypersensitivity and neutrophil degranulation
rationale: Members cover myeloid effector functions (ADCC, complement receptor signaling, neutrophil degranulation, acute antigen-driven inflammation); type II/IV hypersensitivity separates it from C1, and neutrophil degranulation/complement receptors from C2-C4.

qualifier: PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades with Klotho coreceptors
name: FGFR PI3K and PLC-gamma signaling with Klotho coreceptors
rationale: Members are FGFR (largely FGFR4/1) phosphoinositide-linked PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades plus Klotho-dependent ligand binding, which the confusables (isoform ligand binding, FRS/SHC, mutant FGFRs) lack.

qualifier: with myelination and glial injury response
name: Axon regeneration, myelination and glial injury response
rationale: Members span axon growth/regeneration signaling, CNS/PNS myelin formation and maintenance, and glial responses (gliosis, astrocyte migration, OPC proliferation); the myelin and glial members distinguish it from axon-sprouting and Sema3A confusables.

name: Rab/ARF-regulated endocytic recycling of surface and postsynaptic receptors
rationale: Members concern Rab/ARF GTPase control of endocytic recycling, receptor internalization and surface localization including postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptors; the Rab/ARF and cell-surface members separate it from presynaptic and AMPA-trafficking confusables.

name: CSF1–DAP12 signaling in microglial and macrophage activation
rationale: Members are M-CSF/CSF1 and DAP12 tyrosine-kinase signaling driving macrophage proliferation/fusion and microglial activation, migration and cytotoxicity, distinguishing it from GM-CSF differentiation, osteoclast and microglial-inhibition confusables.

core: Post-translational maturation of developmental signaling proteins
qualifier: Notch O-glycosylation and Hedgehog autoprocessing and lipidation
name: Notch O-glycosylation and Hedgehog autoprocessing and lipidation
rationale: Members cover secretory-pathway modification of Notch/TSR proteins by O-fucose/O-glucose and Hedgehog autoprocessing, palmitoylation and release; the Hedgehog processing members separate it from N-glycan, somitogenesis and heparan sulfate confusables.

name: Perinatal alveolar maturation and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: Members cover pneumocyte differentiation, saccular and pulmonary vascular development, perinatal adaptations (hyperoxia, ductus closure) and surfactant metabolism and its genetic defects, which distinguish it from lung-branching and other epithelial confusables.

name: Inflammasome activation, pyroptosis and IL-1/IL-18 maturation
rationale: Members are canonical (NLRP1/3, AIM2, IPAF) and noncanonical caspase-4/5 inflammasomes, pyroptotic death and IL-1/IL-18 processing and signaling, which TLR/LPS and IL-17 confusables lack.

name: Cobalamin plasma transport and intracellular processing disorders
rationale: Members cover transcobalamin/CD320 delivery and MMACHC/MMADHC/ABCD4 intracellular cobalamin processing defects, separating it from intestinal uptake and mitochondrial methylmalonyl-CoA confusables.

name: Nephron tubule morphogenesis via comma- and S-shaped bodies
rationale: All members describe nephron tubule morphogenesis through comma- and S-shaped body stages, distinct from ureteric bud and mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition confusables.

name: V-ATPase-driven acidification of lysosomes, endosomes and phagosomes
rationale: Members concern proton pumping and pH control in lysosomes, endosomes, Golgi and phagosomes (with phagolysosome fusion), the phagosomal members distinguishing it from pigment-granule and ion-exchanger confusables.

name: p53- and mTORC1-regulated NADPH-producing carbon metabolism
rationale: Members are p53/mTORC1/NFE2L2 control of glycolysis, pentose phosphate and TCA flux with NADPH regeneration and isocitrate metabolism, which the hypoxia and broad NFE2L2 confusables lack.

name: Purine ribonucleoside salvage and catabolism with PRPP synthesis
rationale: Members cover HPRT/APRT salvage, PRPP synthesis and ADA/PNP-mediated purine ribonucleoside breakdown, distinct from de novo synthesis and deoxyribonucleotide confusables.

name: PTH-regulated SLC34 sodium-phosphate cotransport and phosphate homeostasis
rationale: Members are type II Na+/Pi (SLC34) transport, its disease variants and phosphate homeostasis including PTH response, separating it from mineralization and anion-exchanger confusables.

core: Unfolded protein and integrated stress responses
name: ER and integrated stress responses with AKT–FOXO survival signaling
rationale: Members span ATF6/IRE1/PERK UPR, eIF2 kinase (GCN2, HRI) translational control, UPRmt and stress-induced apoptosis, plus AKT–FOXO signaling that separates it from chaperone/ER-targeting and NFE2L2 confusables.

name: Promotion of monocyte–macrophage recruitment via RAGE and p38
rationale: Members positively regulate monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation and MCP-1 production, with RAGE and p38 signaling distinguishing it from neutrophil and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: phase I/II with organic anion and bilirubin transport
name: Phase I/II xenobiotic biotransformation and organic anion/bilirubin transport
rationale: Members cover CYP/FMO oxidation, conjugation (glucuronidation, sulfonation, methylation, acetylation), drug ADME and SLCO/ABCC transport including bilirubin, distinct from bile acid and sulfur-metabolism confusables.

name: Neutrophil and monocyte activation with SIRP-mediated phagocytosis restraint
rationale: Members are innate myeloid activation (degranulation, complement and TLR signaling, neutrophil/monocyte modules) with SIRP-mediated negative regulation of phagocytosis, which distinguishes it from chemotaxis/respiratory-burst and hypersensitivity confusables.

name: Axon regeneration and collateral sprouting in injured and intact nerves
rationale: Members regulate axon regrowth and collateral sprouting after injury and without it (RHOA inhibition, CRMP signaling, motor neuron survival), lacking the myelin/glial members of C1/C3 and the guidance repulsion of C2/C4.

qualifier: of cadherin, NPAS4 and PD-L1 mRNAs
name: Translational control of cadherin, NPAS4 and PD-L1 mRNAs
rationale: All members regulate translation of specific mRNAs (CDH1, CDH11, NPAS4, PD-L1), unlike the confusables, which concern general miRNA biogenesis, silencing and decay.

name: Retroviral integration, viral latency and retroelement silencing
rationale: Members cover HIV entry, reverse transcription and integration, viral transcription/latency (HIV, HCMV) and KRAB-ZFP/HUSH silencing of endogenous retroelements, the latter distinguishing it from RNA-virus and APOBEC-editing confusables.

name: Meiotic prophase I recombination and synapsis
rationale: Members cover meiotic DSB formation, recombination, synaptonemal complex and telomere attachment, distinct from confusables about cohesion, segregation and meiotic checkpoints.

name: Rho GTPase-driven promotion of cytokinesis
rationale: Members are the Rho GTPase cycle and positive regulation of cytokinesis, distinct from confusables on spindle, checkpoint and contractile ring/abscission execution.

name: Genotoxic stress responses and liver regeneration
rationale: Members combine UV, cisplatin, bleomycin and phorbol ester responses with hepatocyte proliferation, differentiation and liver regeneration, the liver members distinguishing it from oxidative-stress and senescence confusables.

core: Fc receptor and SIRP immunoreceptor signaling
name: Fc receptor and SIRP tuning of antibody-mediated phagocyte responses
rationale: Members are inhibitory/stimulatory Fc receptor and SIRP signaling regulating phagocytosis, neutrophil and B cell activation and humoral immunity, distinct from FcgR effector/hypersensitivity and neutrophil degranulation confusables.
